def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The puzzle overlays defects/holes on a repeated row pattern. Recover the
    # canonical sequence from the intact top row, then use the next-row phase
    # for every subsequent row.

    start0=((start-1-9)%9)+1

    return [seq0]+[seq[:] for _ in range(h-1)]
